## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      10 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 7 июл. 2026 г. - 18 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _hjgjkhfhgdsdfhgjklhfhdsrueytiu_, 18 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "As a pro user for the last few years, it’s a shame to see forest just keep going downhill - from adding AI slop trees, constant buggy updates, and now finally the new UI which makes returning to the home screen after planting a tree multiple clicks, I’m writing a review to hopefully get things to change. It’s a big shame, I hope they get their act together and remember what the core idea about the app is about."
            2. _Silk14789_, 16 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "The developers have forced a buggy and fastidious update that ruins the app for me. It seems they went for sth “aesthetic” and forgot this a productivity app. At least give us the option to use the old UI back!"
            3. _Garv Malani_, 14 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "the concept is excellent, helping me a lot, but the app is not that great. It feels very slow and every response is delayed. Hope you all will fix it soon"
